title: CPB observed parameter schema
description: A service's parameter schema for one model offering, stored in a pack as observed. The offering's schema_snapshot names this file; model_id, service, model_identifier and observed_at repeat the model record and the offering.

model_id.description: The id of the model record whose offering names this file.

observed_at.description: The date the schema was acquired, as the acquisition records it.

schema.description: The parameter schema exactly as the service gave it.
